note: Take on an empty stomach, 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast, or wait 3 to 4 hours after the evening meal — food can significantly reduce absorption.
Do not take within 4 hours of calcium or iron supplements, and do not take together with antacids or proton pump inhibitors — these reduce absorption.

Antacids, calcium supplements, and magnesium-containing laxatives should be taken 1-2 hours before or after doxycycline; iron products 3 hours before or 2 hours after — these minerals impair absorption and reduce effectiveness.

Take first thing in the morning on an empty stomach with a full glass of plain water. Remain fully upright (sitting or standing) for at least 30 minutes afterward, and wait at least 30 minutes before eating, drinking anything else, or taking any other medication.
Avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 3 days after the last dose — can cause a disulfiram-like reaction (abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, headache, flushing).
